data.title: Data entities
data.subtitle: The logical data the processes create, read, update and delete.
data.empty: No data entities yet. Add the first one.
data.numberMinted: The DE number is assigned when you save.
data.name: Entity name
data.reloaded: Reloaded the latest version. Your changes are still in the form: check them and save again.
data.retireEntityBody: {label} will be retired. It can be restored later. An entity that still has fields or requirement links cannot be retired.
data.retiredBanner: This entity is retired. Restore it to edit it or its fields.
data.check.fkNoField: Foreign key without a target field: {names}
data.check.fkAllFields: Every foreign key names its target field
data.usedByNone: No requirement uses this entity yet.
data.field.name: Field name
data.field.groupHelp: Relationship numbers are assigned by the system. Choose an existing one only to build a key of several fields.
data.field.duplicate: This entity already has a field with that name.
data.field.retireBody: {name} will be retired. A field that another field's foreign key points at cannot be retired.
data.field.gone: This field was retired by someone else. Close and reload the page.
data.field.reloaded: Reloaded the latest version. Your changes are still in the form: check them and save again.
data.loadFailed: Could not load this. Reload the page to try again.
data.check.unavailable: Checks appear once the fields have loaded.
data.erd.title: Entity relationship diagram
data.erd.subtitle: The logical model as drawn from the declared keys. Relationships come only from foreign-key fields, so the diagram is exactly as complete as the model.
data.erd.empty: No data entities in this scope yet.
data.erd.emptyArea: No process under this node reads or writes a data entity yet.
data.erd.help: Drag a card to place it; the place is saved for everyone. Click a card to highlight its neighbours, double-click to open the entity.
data.erd.helpReadOnly: Click a card to highlight its neighbours, double-click to open the entity. You can view this diagram but not rearrange it.
data.erd.arrangeHelp: Re-arranges every card that was never placed by hand. Nothing is saved.
data.erd.resetBody: Every saved card position on this diagram is removed, and so is every collapse or expand choice: cards go back to their default size and are arranged automatically. Entities and fields are not changed. Other subject areas keep their own layouts.
data.erd.noKeyHelp: This entity has no primary-key field yet.
data.erd.collapse: Show fewer fields. This saves the card's current place too, which pins it there.
data.erd.expand: Show all fields. This saves the card's current place too, which pins it there.
data.erd.collapseLocal: Show fewer fields (only on your screen)
data.erd.expandLocal: Show all fields (only on your screen)
data.erd.table.none: No relationships in this scope. A relationship appears when a field is marked as a foreign key.
data.erd.layoutFailed: The diagram could not be arranged: {message}
data.erd.mermaidHelp: Copies this diagram as Mermaid text, to paste into a document or a slide tool that renders Mermaid.
data.erd.mermaidCopied: Mermaid text copied to the clipboard.
data.erd.mermaidFailed: The Mermaid text could not be fetched.
data.erd.mermaidManualHelp: This browser did not allow copying to the clipboard. Select the text below and copy it.
data.import.title: Import from Excel
data.import.target.entitiesHelp: Add new entities, or change the name, description and owner note of existing ones. Nothing is retired by an import.
data.import.getFile: 1. Start from a template or an export
data.import.getFileHelp: A template is empty: fill in new rows. An export holds the live rows: edit them, and add new rows below. Keep the hidden first row and the row-token column as they are.
data.import.downloaded: {name} downloaded. Fill it in Excel, save it, then choose it below.
data.import.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded.
data.import.pickFileHelp: An .xlsx file of up to 10 MB. It is read when you choose it: if you change it in Excel afterwards, choose it again.
data.import.tooBig: This file is larger than 10 MB, the most one upload can carry.
data.import.wrongType: The server did not accept this as an .xlsx file.
data.import.readFailed: The file could not be read. Check it is closed in Excel and choose it again.
data.import.busy: Other uploads are being checked right now. Try again in a moment.
data.import.purged: This upload is more than 90 days old, so its rows are no longer kept. Only the totals remain.
data.import.noRows: No rows to show with this filter.
data.import.fixErrors: {n} rows have errors, so nothing can be applied yet. Fix them in Excel, save, and upload the file again.
data.import.rejected: This upload was rejected and cannot be applied: the rows below show why. Fix the file in Excel and upload it again.
data.import.nothingToChange: Every row matches what is already saved. Applying this changes nothing.
data.import.confirmBody: This will CREATE {n} new rows. Type {n} to confirm.
data.import.confirmMismatch: That is not the number of new rows.
data.import.committed: Applied: {inserts} added, {updates} changed, {matches} unchanged. The list now shows them.
data.import.alreadyCommitted: This upload had already been applied.
data.import.stale: This upload changed since you opened it. The preview has been reloaded: check it and apply again.
data.import.notCommittable: This upload can no longer be applied.
data.import.retry: The database was busy, so nothing was applied. Apply again.
data.import.msg.INVALID: This value is not valid here: {reason}
data.import.msg.FORMULA_NO_VALUE: This cell holds a formula with no calculated value. Open the file in Excel, save it, and upload it again.
data.import.msg.CELL_ERROR: This cell holds an Excel error value.
data.import.msg.TOKEN_INVALID: This row's token is not one VB issued, or it was edited. Re-export.
data.import.msg.TOKEN_OTHER_TABLE: This row's token belongs to another kind of record. Re-export.
data.import.msg.TOKEN_ROW_MISMATCH: This row's token belongs to {token_key}, not {key}: the rows were sorted or shifted. Re-export.
data.import.msg.ROW_RETIRED: {key} was retired or changed since export: re-export.
data.import.msg.EXPORT_FIRST: {key}: export first to update. A row with a number needs the row token from an export.
data.import.msg.NAME_EXISTS: A live data entity already has this name: {key}.
data.import.msg.NAME_TAKEN: Another live data entity already has this name: {key}.
data.import.msg.VERDICT_CHANGED: This row would now be {now}, not {was}: the data changed since the upload. Upload the file again.
data.import.msg.APPLY_FAILED: This row could not be applied: {reason}
data.import.msg.COLUMN_IGNORED: Column {column} is not part of this import and was ignored.
